proofs.text: Call `pending()` on the v0.9.5 fixture and verify it reports `os-tags`, `untracked-files`, `config`, `workflows`, `plugin-copies` and `records` and does not report `hooks`; write a retired pre-commit shim into a copy of it and verify `hooks` is reported as well

rule_text: The detectors read the layout v0.9.5 left, and what that layout leaves behind is what they report; a project that carries a retired hook has the hook migration reported too

tests.name: test_a_project_with_no_hooks_needs_no_hook_migration
test_the_v095_layout_needs_the_migrations_that_layout_left

tests.body:
def test_a_retired_hook_adds_the_hook_migration(tmp_path):
    root = _project(tmp_path, V095)
    _write(root, '.purlin/hooks/pre-commit', OLD_PRE_COMMIT)
    found = _ids(root)
    assert 'hooks' in found, found
    for expected in ('os-tags', 'untracked-files', 'config', 'workflows',
                     'plugin-copies', 'records'):
        assert expected in found, found
